== Biography ==
He is from [[wikipedia:en:São Paulo|São Paulo]], Brazil. 
== Trivia ==
<tabber>
General Trivia=
===General Trivia===
* Is a fan of [[Xun]].
* Well known for being good mechanically with most champions, especially {{ci|Lee Sin}}.
* Nicknamed "'''Marechal'''" (marshal) by his supporters.
* He said in a podcast he fell in love with {{ci|Karthus}} and {{ci|Evelynn}} after spending his vacation playing both champions.<ref>[https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxAS6JFj9O5JaUhuZgy7DmEMPHX1cgAA5N?si=Mh3RnzHCBdlkKx0v Aegis talks about Karthus and Evelynn in MD3 Podcast] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Got famous in the chinese social network '''[[wikipedia:en:Weibo|Weibo]]''' after his elimination in [[MSI 2022]].<ref>[https://ge.globo.com/esports/lol/noticia/2022/05/14/msi-2022-brasileiro-viraliza-na-china-apos-eliminacao-bonitao.ghtml MSI 2022: brasileiro viraliza na China após eliminação: "Bonitão"] ''ge.globo.com''</ref>
* After winning [[2023_Season_Kickoff/Brazil|Season Kickoff Brazil 2023]], he decided on creating a {{ci|Aphelios}} emote who resembles his face after being eliminated in [[MSI 2022]].<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/ApheliosMains/comments/11nx1u9/aphelios_emote_on_pbe/ Aphelios Emote on PBE]''reddit.com''</ref>
|-|
Non-League-related Trivia=
=== Non-League-related Trivia ===
* Is a big fan of the band '''[[wikipedia:en:One Ok Rock|ONE OK ROCK]]'''.
* Nicknamed '''[[wikipedia:en:Kevin Durant|Kevin Durant]]''' by the Brazilian community after engaging in a discussion with the retired LoL proplayer [[Drop (Matheus Herdy)|Drop]] and comparing himself to the NBA player with that name.<ref>[https://x.com/Aegislol1/status/1757796728718176403 Aegis' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* He met [[Grevthar]] through a friend while he was at [[RED Academy]], played with him a couple duo games, invited him to join the team and became his duo ever since. 
** When [[Grevthar]] was promoted to the main team, he discovered that he was in the team's Gaming House doing a duo with [[Revolta]] on livestream.
* Revealed during a podcast that while he was in [[RED Academy]], he and his team hated everyone in the main team except [[TitaN]], which had [[Revolta]] and [[YoDa (Felipe Noronha)|YoDa]].<ref>[https://youtu.be/2yEdx_f7Uiw?si=f9erTYuuu0KDR2Ih A JORNADA dos ACADEMY e o PLOT TWIST do GREVTHAR] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Because of his haircut, he is often called a "emo", even though he doesn't consider himself one.
* There is a running joke that he always gets stuck in the bathroom of the team's Gaming Office.<ref>[https://x.com/REDCanids/status/1881882134996275297 RED Canids' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
|-|
Notable Achievements=
=== Notable Achievements ===
* Currently holds the record for the longest-serving active player in a single organization in the '''CBLOL''', playing for [[RED Canids]] from 2018 to 2025.<ref>[https://twitter.com/RedKingOfBrega/status/1742233308748984746 RedKingOfBrega's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* His 2v2 ending play with [[fNb]] was featured in a '''LoL Esports Top 5 Plays of the Week''' as '''Top 5'''.<ref>[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1829202352353468790 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
|-|
Awards=
=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x CBLOL Player of the Year (2021)<ref>[https://ge.globo.com/esports/lol/noticia/premio-cblol-aegis-leva-tres-trofeus-e-red-canids-domina.ghtml Prêmio CBLOL: Aegis leva três troféus, e RED Canids domina"] ''ge.globo.com''</ref>
* 1X CBLOL Rookie of the Year (2021)
* 1x CBLOL Jungler of the Year (2021)
* 2x CBLOL Finals MVP (Summer 2021, Spring 2022)
